events.title: 안드레스 에스코바르 피살 — 콜롬비아 대표팀 수비수 안드레스 에스코바르가 메데인에서 살해됐다. 월드컵 자책골을 둘러싼 보도와 사건의 형사적 경위를 단순화하지 않고 구분해야 한다.

The Republic of Ireland's World Cup dream ends with a 2-0 defeat to Holland in the Orlando last 16 clash. The only English based player still active in the World Cup is Bulgarian striker Boncho Genchev of 입스위치 타운.
토트넘 홋스퍼 's 12-point penalty is reduced to 6 points on appeal at a Football Association hearing, while the £600,000 fine is increased to £1.5 million and the FA Cup ban remains in place.

The Netherlands national team is eliminated in the quarterfinals of the 1994 FIFA World Cup by eventual winners Brazil. Branco scores the decisive goal in the 3–2 win for the South Americans. 로날트 쿠만 (78th cap), 프랑크 레이카르트 (73rd) and 얀 바우터르스 (70th) play their last international match for the Netherlands.
Graham 배로 , manager of newly promoted 체스터 시티 , stuns the club by handing in his resignation, after being told that he must break up and sell off his promotion-winning side.

그레이엄 테일러 prepares for a Division One promotion challenge with 울버햄프턴 원더러스 , signing defender Steve Froggatt from 애스턴 빌라 for £1 million, while Clayton Blackmore ( 맨체스터 유나이티드 's longest-serving player) signs for 미들즈브러 on a free transfer to join 브라이언 롭슨 's fellow promotion hopefuls.
셰필드 웬즈데이 sign midfielder Ian Taylor from 포트 베일 for £1 million.
블랙번 로버스 pay a national record £5 million for 노리치 시티 's 21-year-old striker Chris Sutton .
Bulgaria are beaten 2-1 by Italy in the World Cup semi-finals, ending the representation of English based players at the World Cup.
체스터 시티 announce former England international and 포트 베일 coach Mike Pejic as their new manager.

Brazil wins its record fourth World Cup, defeating Italy on penalties in the final of the 1994 FIFA World Cup in Pasadena, California . Superstar 디에고 마라도나 was suspended from Cup competition for doping on Ephedrine .
블랙풀 appoint 프레스턴 노스 엔드 assistant manager 샘 앨러다이스 as their new manager.
브라이언 롭슨 further bolsters 미들즈브러's squad with a £1 million move for 애스턴 빌라 defender Neil Cox .
레스터 시티 , newly promoted to the Premier League and in the top flight for the first time since 1987, pay a club record £1.25 million for 노츠 카운티 midfielder Mark Draper .
